mentions.author: duxup
mentions.story: Museum Excavation in Cologne Finds Ancient Roman Governor's Palace and Basilica
mentions.why: Famous scene asking what Roman rule gave conquered peoples.
mentions.quote: The breadth and depth of Roman bureaucracy and government always amazes me. The contrast between the corruption / at times cut throat politics at the top / end of the republic, and at the same time serious efforts to maintain a reasonable and functional government structure…

mentions.author: interroboink
mentions.why: Classic Life of Brian scene listing the benefits of Roman rule.
mentions.quote: > Where do you think the things people today spend all their time politicking on would rank? I realize "politicking" is often used in a derogatory sense, and perhaps that's how you mean it here, but there is a whole lot of plain-old-politics that takes place on a regular basis…
